purpose: Post-hoc development-only adjudication track for the 15 wave-2 candidates previously labeled legitimate_nonbenchmark_discrepancy.
interpretation_limits: VERIFIED_INTERNAL_DISCREPANCY means only that source-backed quantities do not reconcile under the stated relation; it does not mean the paper is wrong.
The original JATS source hashes were pinned and verified, but item-by-item fidelity against publisher PDF layout was not independently established for this adjudication track.
Supplement resolution, comprehensive correction-history search, clinical or scientific importance, and effects on conclusions were not assessed for these 15 items.
These items are development material and must not enter a future unseen evaluation denominator.

cases.relation: explicit count divided by the explicit column denominator versus displayed percentage
cases.evidence_summary: The locked row has count 14, denominator 152, and displayed 92%; those operands do not reconcile under the frozen display-precision rule.
cases.source_explanation: No explanation was recorded in the source-backed adjudication notes.
cases.correction_status: not a declared correction target in wave 2
cases.local_denominator_or_rounding: No row-specific denominator or rounding rule reconciles this large difference in the locked capture.
cases.extraction_fidelity: source hash bound; visual table fidelity not independently assessed
